import asyncio
import hashlib
import json
import math
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from coreai.runtime import AIModel, NDArray, SpecializationOptions
from transformers import AutoTokenizer

from evaluate_d3 import summary

sys.path.insert(0, "/Users/devil/Pro/d3-edge-coreai/bundle")
from coreai_d3 import pack
from d3_format import SYSTEM_PROMPT, user_prompt

ACTIONS = ("interrupt", "discard", "enqueue")
ROOT = Path("/Users/devil/Pro/MobileHarness")
BASELINE = ROOT / "docs/measurements/duplex-d3-lite-edge-coreai-2026-11-15.json"


async def main():
    model_name, model_dir, apple_path, output_file = sys.argv[1:]
    root, apple, output = map(Path, (model_dir, apple_path, output_file))
    report = json.loads(apple.read_text())
    baseline = json.loads(BASELINE.read_text())
    source = baseline["models"][model_name]["source"]
    graph = root / "decision.aimodel"
    with (graph / "main.mlirb").open("rb") as source_file:
        assert hashlib.file_digest(source_file, "sha256").hexdigest() == source["sha256"]
    manifest = json.loads((root / "manifest.json").read_text())
    codes = json.loads((root / "decision_config.json").read_text())["codes"]
    assert codes[:3] == ["A", "B", "C"]
    start = time.perf_counter()
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(root, local_files_only=True)
    model = await AIModel.load(graph, SpecializationOptions.default())
    fn = model.load_function("main")
    extra = {}
    if "visual_embeddings" in manifest["inputs"]:
        capacity = manifest["sequence_length"]
        extra = dict(
            visual_embeddings=NDArray(np.zeros((1, capacity, manifest["hidden_size"]), dtype=np.float32)),
            visual_mask=NDArray(np.zeros((1, capacity, 1), dtype=np.bool_)),
        )
    print(model_name, "load ms", round((time.perf_counter()-start)*1000, 2), flush=True)
    cases = report["cases"]
    archived = {("frozen-"+lang,r["id"]):r["prompt"] for lang,condition in baseline["models"][model_name]["conditions"].items()
                for r in condition["rows"]}
    marker = json.loads((ROOT/"MobileHarness/Resources/Agents/Assistant/InputDecision.json").read_text())["templates"]["latest"].split("{{")[0]
    marker_zh = json.loads((ROOT/"MobileHarness/Resources/Agents/Assistant/InputDecision.zh-Hans.json").read_text())["templates"]["latest"].split("{{")[0]

    async def run(case):
        start = time.perf_counter()
        if case["digits"]:
            prefix = marker_zh if case["condition"].endswith("zh-Hans") else marker
            state, latest = case["user"].rsplit("\n\n"+prefix, 1)
            user = user_prompt(state, dict(type="choice", instructions=prefix+latest, criteria=dict.fromkeys("123")), codes)
            system = SYSTEM_PROMPT
        else:
            system, user = case["system"], case["user"]
        rendered = tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
            [{"role":"system", "content":system}, {"role":"user", "content":user}],
            tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True, enable_thinking=False)
        key = (case["condition"],case["id"])
        if not case["digits"]:
            assert archived[key] == rendered, key
        encoded = tokenizer([rendered], add_special_tokens=False, return_tensors="np")
        values = {k:NDArray(v) for k,v in pack(encoded,manifest).items()}
        scores = (await fn(values | extra))[manifest["output"]].numpy()[0,:3]
        assert len(scores) == 3 and np.isfinite(scores).all(), key
        prediction = ACTIONS[int(scores.argmax())]
        elapsed = (time.perf_counter()-start)*1000
        row = dict(id=case["id"], suite=case["condition"], expected=case["expected"], inputTokens=int(encoded["input_ids"].shape[1]),
                   prediction=prediction, elapsedMS=elapsed, scores=scores.tolist())
        if case["digits"]:
            row["prompt"] = rendered
        return row

    groups = {}
    for condition in dict.fromkeys(c["condition"] for c in cases):
        inputs = [c for c in cases if c["condition"] == condition]
        for _ in range(3):
            await run(inputs[0])
        rows = [await run(case) for case in inputs]
        metrics = summary(rows,500)
        if condition.startswith("frozen-"):
            metrics["historicalPredictionChanges"] = sum(r["prediction"] != c[model_name] for r,c in zip(rows,inputs,strict=True))
        groups[condition] = dict(summary=metrics, rows=rows)
        print(model_name,condition,metrics,flush=True)
        output.write_text(json.dumps(dict(source=source, conditions=groups, warmupsPerCondition=3,
                                          runtime="Core AI default via Python; raw decisions", reproductionSource=Path(__file__).read_text()),
                                     ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+"\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

import asyncio
import hashlib
import json
import math
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from coreai.runtime import AIModel, NDArray, SpecializationOptions
from transformers import AutoTokenizer

from evaluate_d3 import summary

sys.path.insert(0, "/Users/devil/Pro/d3-edge-coreai/bundle")
from coreai_d3 import pack
from d3_format import SYSTEM_PROMPT, user_prompt

ACTIONS = ("interrupt", "discard", "enqueue")
ROOT = Path("/Users/devil/Pro/MobileHarness")
BASELINE = ROOT / "docs/measurements/duplex-d3-lite-edge-coreai-2026-11-15.json"


async def main():
    model_name, model_dir, apple_path, output_file = sys.argv[1:]
    root, apple, output = map(Path, (model_dir, apple_path, output_file))
    report = json.loads(apple.read_text())
    baseline = json.loads(BASELINE.read_text())
    source = baseline["models"][model_name]["source"]
    graph = root / "decision.aimodel"
    with (graph / "main.mlirb").open("rb") as source_file:
        assert hashlib.file_digest(source_file, "sha256").hexdigest() == source["sha256"]
    manifest = json.loads((root / "manifest.json").read_text())
    codes = json.loads((root / "decision_config.json").read_text())["codes"]
    assert codes[:3] == ["A", "B", "C"]
    start = time.perf_counter()
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(root, local_files_only=True)
    model = await AIModel.load(graph, SpecializationOptions.default())
    fn = model.load_function("main")
    extra = {}
    if "visual_embeddings" in manifest["inputs"]:
        capacity = manifest["sequence_length"]
        extra = dict(
            visual_embeddings=NDArray(np.zeros((1, capacity, manifest["hidden_size"]), dtype=np.float32)),
            visual_mask=NDArray(np.zeros((1, capacity, 1), dtype=np.bool_)),
        )
    print(model_name, "load ms", round((time.perf_counter()-start)*1000, 2), flush=True)
    cases = report["cases"]
    archived = {("frozen-"+lang,r["id"]):r["prompt"] for lang,condition in baseline["models"][model_name]["conditions"].items()
                for r in condition["rows"]}
    marker = json.loads((ROOT/"MobileHarness/Resources/Agents/Assistant/InputDecision.json").read_text())["templates"]["latest"].split("{{")[0]
    marker_zh = json.loads((ROOT/"MobileHarness/Resources/Agents/Assistant/InputDecision.zh-Hans.json").read_text())["templates"]["latest"].split("{{")[0]

    async def run(case):
        start = time.perf_counter()
        if case["digits"]:
            prefix = marker_zh if case["condition"].endswith("zh-Hans") else marker
            state, latest = case["user"].rsplit("\n\n"+prefix, 1)
            user = user_prompt(state, dict(type="choice", instructions=prefix+latest, criteria=dict.fromkeys("123")), codes)
            system = SYSTEM_PROMPT
        else:
            system, user = case["system"], case["user"]
        rendered = tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
            [{"role":"system", "content":system}, {"role":"user", "content":user}],
            tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True, enable_thinking=False)
        key = (case["condition"],case["id"])
        if not case["digits"]:
            assert archived[key] == rendered, key
        encoded = tokenizer([rendered], add_special_tokens=False, return_tensors="np")
        values = {k:NDArray(v) for k,v in pack(encoded,manifest).items()}
        scores = (await fn(values | extra))[manifest["output"]].numpy()[0,:3]
        assert len(scores) == 3 and np.isfinite(scores).all(), key
        prediction = ACTIONS[int(scores.argmax())]
        elapsed = (time.perf_counter()-start)*1000
        row = dict(id=case["id"], suite=case["condition"], expected=case["expected"], inputTokens=int(encoded["input_ids"].shape[1]),
                   prediction=prediction, elapsedMS=elapsed, scores=scores.tolist())
        if case["digits"]:
            row["prompt"] = rendered
        return row

    groups = {}
    for condition in dict.fromkeys(c["condition"] for c in cases):
        inputs = [c for c in cases if c["condition"] == condition]
        for _ in range(3):
            await run(inputs[0])
        rows = [await run(case) for case in inputs]
        metrics = summary(rows,500)
        if condition.startswith("frozen-"):
            metrics["historicalPredictionChanges"] = sum(r["prediction"] != c[model_name] for r,c in zip(rows,inputs,strict=True))
        groups[condition] = dict(summary=metrics, rows=rows)
        print(model_name,condition,metrics,flush=True)
        output.write_text(json.dumps(dict(source=source, conditions=groups, warmupsPerCondition=3,
                                          runtime="Core AI default via Python; raw decisions", reproductionSource=Path(__file__).read_text()),
                                     ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+"\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
